description: Fieldy lets users retrieve and review their recorded real-world conversations in ChatGPT and Codex. Users can browse recent conversations or a specific date range, open a conversation with its transcript, and inspect exact transcript lines. All available tools are read-only.

defaultPrompt: Summarize my most recent conversations and extract decisions and action items.
What did I promise people this week? Make me a prioritized follow-up list.
Help me prepare for my next conversation with [person] using what we discussed last time.
